oneLine: Advent International to invest $328.5 million in Yatharth Hospitals

sources.title: Advent International to invest $328.5 million in India's Yatharth Hospitals for 24.9% stake

synopsis: US-based private equity firm Advent International announced an investment of ₹3,150 crore ($328.53 million) in Indian hospital chain operator Yatharth Hospitals. The investment secures Advent International a 24.9 per cent stake in the company. The transaction was reported on September 17, 2026.
